scripts.build:rules-wasm: cd ../.. && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && mkdir -p apps/web/worker/wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/fewfc.wasm apps/web/worker/wasm/fewfc.wasm
scripts.cf:dev: bun run build && bun db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: bun run validate:deploy staging && bun run build:staging && bun db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.cf:deploy:production: bun run validate:deploy production && bun run build:production && bun db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply fewfc-auth-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply fewfc-auth-production --remote --env production
scripts.test:unit: bun test app shared worker scripts
scripts.test:e2e:server: bun tests/e2e/prepare-storage.ts && bun run build && bun db:migrate:local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --port 8727 --var LOCAL_PASSWORD_RESET_ENABLED:true --var BETTER_AUTH_URL:http://localhost:8727
scripts.test:e2e:server:built: bun tests/e2e/prepare-storage.ts && bun db:migrate:local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --port 8727 --var LOCAL_PASSWORD_RESET_ENABLED:true --var BETTER_AUTH_URL:http://localhost:8727
